name: AgentClinic
description: AgentClinic is a multimodal agent benchmark designed to evaluate large language models in simulated clinical environments involving patient interactions, multimodal data collection, and tool usage across nine medical specialties and seven languages. It captures the complexity of sequential clinical decision-making beyond static question-answering.
reputation: A recent multimodal clinical-agent benchmark that has attracted interest for testing sequential decision-making and tool use in medicine, but it is not yet a long-established community standard.
notes: Includes real-world EHR data, clinical reader study, bias perturbations, and novel patient-centric metrics enabled by interactive environment.
